name: Magnetic door holder plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for an electromagnetic door holder that keeps fire doors open and releases them on alarm.
description: Electromagnetic door holders keep fire doors open during normal use and release them when the fire alarm operates or the supply fails. Plans draw a small box against the wall at the door swing with an M or DH tag, linked to the fire alarm interface.

The holder is fail-safe: loss of power releases the door. The plan should show the interface relay or module and the supply, so the installer can wire the release correctly. The symbol does not show holding force or the door closer, which is a door hardware item.
readingNotes: Check the door swing and holder position.
Find the alarm interface that releases it.
distinction: A door contact only reports door position; a door holder keeps a fire door open until alarm.
